To keep Mini 4x4 racing fun, exciting and fair, we have developed a set of competition rules. All participants in official Mini 4WD events must comply with these regulations. Mini 4x4 racing isn't just about being the fastest, it's also about using your brains and good setup techniques. Not only can you compete with other racers, but you can also challenge yourself. By remembering the spirit of fair play, you can learn how to compete honorably with good manners. We sincerely hope that every Mini 4x4 enthusiast will comply with these regulations. All players must understand that "energy protection", "super acceleration" and "invincible protection" are prohibited under this rule, which is a challenge to the reasonable matching of vehicles.

All competition vehicles must be four-wheel drive. Modified rear-wheel drive or front-wheel drive participation is not allowed. Bodies must be secured to the competition vehicle so that they do not fall off and the body must have a sticker or paint method 1). Homemade bodies will not be accepted All participating vehicles must undergo a vehicle inspection. Participating vehicles that do not pass the vehicle inspection will not be allowed to participate in the race. Competition vehicles must be assembled by the athletes themselves (Note 2). However, depending on the content of the competition, joint assembly may be allowed.

The body dimensions of participating vehicles are as follows. (Common to all chassis)Competition vehicles must be four-wheel drive.*Maximum width: 105 mm or less*Overall height: 70 mm or less*Overall length: 165 mm or less Minimum ground clearance: 1 mm or more*Minimum weight for all devices: 90 grams or more (including battery and motor)*Tire size: front and rear wheels, diameter: 22~35mm, width: 8 to 26mm (tires must be installed)
